messages:
emily: FYI vault audit delivery for namespace 'partners-onboard' dropped at ~07:11 UTC after the RBAC cleanup job. noticed a ~13m gap.

rohit: i rolled a cleanup that removed several stale service accounts from the infra project at 07:09. did we accidentally remove the sink writer or KMS unwraper?

iam-bot: Change logged: removed serviceAccount:sa-temp-integrator@redwood at 07:09:12 by rohit.

tara: which SA writes the sink? kms-audit-bot, can you show last writer events?

kms-audit-bot: Last sink write for namespace partners-onboard: 2026-05-02T07:10:58Z by serviceAccount:svc-audit-writer@redwood-project. Role cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter previously bound to serviceAccount:kms-unwrapper@infra (removed).

emily: ok, backups exist at gs://redwood-audit-backups/partners-onboard/*.enc. prefer human-decrypt for chain-of-custody. who from secops can decrypt?

luis: secops can run manual decrypt. i'll take it. requesting list of object names and key resource id.

emily: objects: partners-2026-05-02-07-03.enc .. partners-2026-05-02-07-15.enc. key: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/secops/cryptoKeys/evidence. please copy wrapped blobs to gs://secops-evidence/INC-2026-215 first.

evidence-bot: wrapped blobs copied to gs://secops-evidence/INC-2026-215/; access=secops-only; sha256s will be recorded after decrypt.

luis: decrypting and scanning now. grep rules: "VAULT_TOKEN|AWS_SECRET|GCP_SERVICE_KEY|PRIVATE_KEY". will post any hits.

vault-bot: import dry-run: 89 events available, 1 blob shows truncated EOF (07-07).

luis: scan result: found a partial GCP service key JSON in 07-05.plain; it includes client_email and a truncated private_key. treating as exposed.

rohit: rotate that GCP key immediately, disable the old key version and generate new key. tara, can you update partner onboarding infra to use the new key?

tara: on it. steps:
```
# disable old key
gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable OLD_KEY_ID --project=redwood-project
# create new key and upload to secret store
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create new-key.json --iam-account=sa-partner-ingest@redwood-project
kubectl -n partners set secret generic partner-ingest-key --from-file=key=new-key.json
kubectl rollout restart deploy/partner-ingest -n partners
```

evidence-bot: plaintext artifacts uploaded to gs://secops-evidence/INC-2026-215/plain/ with sha256s recorded. ACL=secops-only.

vault-bot: after manual import (non-dry-run): 88 events imported, 1 event dropped (corrupted blob).

emily: actions checklist: (1) old GCP key disabled (tara) [done], (2) partner-ingest creds rotated and deployment restarted (tara) [in_progress], (3) evidence sealed (luis) [done], (4) revert any temporary perms — none granted.

rohit: follow-ups: add pre-RBAC-sweep gating to detect owned sink writers and KMS bindings, add backup integrity check to CI that rejects empty/truncated wrapped blobs, and add a detector for service account keys present in plaintext blobs. filing infra tickets.

luis: incident INC-2026-215 created, owners: emily (secops), rohit (infra), tara (onboard). uploading artifacts and timeline. link: https://internal.redwood/incident/INC-2026-215

emily: closing loop here once partner confirms no external access used the old key. thanks all :thumbsup:
